crossRefs.note: Absalom did this sort of thing to all Israel who came to the king for judgment. So Absalom stole the hearts of the men…

translations.web: I saw all the living who walk under the sun, that they were with the youth, the other, who succeeded him.
translations.bsb: I saw that all who lived and walked under the sun followed this second one, the youth who succeeded the king.
translations.kjv: I considered all the living which walk under the sun, with the second child that shall stand up
translations.asv: I saw all the living that walk under the sun, that they were with the youth, the second, that stood up in his stead.
